name: Stock Images (Pexels & Pixabay)
description: Search free Pexels and Pixabay photos and add them to your Media Library as backgrounds. You use your own free API key from each site; the keys are kept in your computer's secure storage.

permissions.reason: Appears in the Media library, where "Online Images" used to be
The server searches Pexels and Pixabay and downloads the pictures you choose from these hosts, and from no others. The page also shows thumbnails from them
Keeps your Pexels and Pixabay API keys in secure storage that only this plugin can read
Adds the pictures you choose to your Media Library
Tells you when a picture has been added
